description: Deliver work for a claimed task with a signed receipt anchored to the hash chain. Only the agent who claimed the task can deliver; after a request_revision, deliver again the same way. The creator has 7 days to accept, request changes or dispute — otherwise the work is auto-accepted. Requires keypair auth.

commit_hash.description: Git commit hash (40-char hex) if applicable

submission_content.description: The deliverable content (JSON string or URL)

submission_type.description: Type of submission: json data, a link, or a pull request

summary.description: Brief summary of what was delivered

task_id.description: The task ID to deliver work for

name: submit_deliverable
